title: PrivacyPR: A Dataset of Real-World Privacy Fixes for Benchmarking Privacy-Aware Code Review
abstract: arXiv:2611.18293v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coding agents increasingly review code, yet whether they catch the privacy defects that laws such as the GDPR require software to avoid remains largely untested, partly because few datasets connect real privacy defects to their accepted fixes and review context. We present PrivacyPR, a dataset of 4,131 merged GitHub pull requests (PRs) from 1,469 repositories, created between June 2018 and January 2024. Each PR includes its commits, diffs, review discussion, and LLM-generated labels for privacy relevance, fix type, and GDPR principles. PrivacyPR provides 1,169 high-confidence privacy fixes and 1,643 non-fix PRs, together with Verified, a manually checked split of 250 privacy fixes and 250 non-fix PRs, and Small, a 100 + 100 subset for evaluation. On Verified, both annotators endorsed 72% of the LLM's GDPR-principle assignments. Beyond supporting empirical study of how privacy defects arise and are fixed, PrivacyPR provides a benchmark

translated_title: PrivacyPR：一个用于隐私感知代码审查基准测试的真实世界隐私修复数据集
translated_abstract: 编码智能体越来越多地参与代码审查，但它们能否发现GDPR等法律要求软件避免的隐私缺陷，这在很大程度上仍未得到检验，部分原因在于很少有数据集将真实的隐私缺陷与其被接受的修复方案及审查上下文联系起来。我们提出了PrivacyPR，这是一个包含来自1,469个仓库的4,131个已合并GitHub拉取请求（PR）的数据集，创建时间为2018年6月至2024年1月。每个PR都包含其提交记录、代码差异、审查讨论，以及由大语言模型生成的隐私相关性、修复类型和GDPR原则标签。PrivacyPR提供了1,169个高置信度隐私修复和1,643个非修复PR，还包括Verified（一个经人工核验的子集，包含250个隐私修复和250个非修复PR）以及Small（一个100+100的评估子集）。在Verified子集上，两名标注者均认可了LLM所做GDPR原则标注中的72%。除了支持对隐私缺陷如何产生和修复的实证研究之外，PrivacyPR还提供了一个基准测试平台。
tldr: 该论文提出了PrivacyPR数据集，包含4,131个带LLM生成的隐私相关性和GDPR原则标注的真实GitHub拉取请求，为评估编码智能体能否在代码审查中发现法律要求的隐私缺陷提供了首个大规模基准。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces PrivacyPR, a dataset of 4,131 real-world GitHub pull requests with LLM-generated privacy relevance and GDPR principle labels, providing the first large-scale benchmark for evaluating whether coding agents can detect privacy defects during code review.
